lexical.query: What experimental or observational mechanism context is reported in the offered sources? Identify reported manipulation or exposure, model and population, comparator, measured endpoint and timing when supplied. Distinguish reported findings from the source authors' proposals and from your inference. State how context limits applicability to the case hypothesis. Missing fields remain unprovided; do not assume absent biology or clinical benefit.

What genetic exposure/outcome evidence is reported in the offered sources? Identify exposure and outcome orientation, study design, instruments/proxies, discovery and replication where reported, estimates/units and uncertainty when supplied. Separate cited prior findings from the present study. Explain supported conclusions and limits of transfer to the intended intervention, modality and tissue. Do not equate nonsignificance with absence, infer an unknown scale or convert a genetic exposure association into a drug effect.
